Application is containerized, running Python on Linux/AWS — all favorable for ARM (AWS Graviton). Python 3.x is ARM-compatible. Once upgraded to a current Python version, ARM migration is feasible.

Apache Tomcat 6.1 is EOL since December 2016. For a Python analytics application, Tomcat is also an unusual choice — this may indicate a legacy deployment. Upgrading to Tomcat 10.x or replacing with a Python-native WSGI server (Gunicorn/uvicorn) is appropriate.
